How to get a loan from a credit union?
How to refinance a car with a credit union?
How to get a car loan from a credit union?
What is a share certificate at a credit union?
What is a membership share account at a credit union?
How do I join Logix Federal Credit Union?

paragraphs: Your deposits in a credit union are federally insured by the National Credit Union Share Insurance Fund, an arm of the NCUA. This insurance is similar to coverage offered by the FDIC, and both are backed by the full faith and credit of the United States government.
You may obtain additional coverage on multiple accounts you have with Logix if you have different ownership interests or rights (and you properly complete account forms and applications).

While all credit unions are different, the best way to get a loan from any credit union is to simply ask, whether in a branch, on the phone, or on their website. At Logix, we make it easy to apply for a loan online and you'll find the application at the top of each loan page. This process will include the additional benefit of helping you become a Logix member with access to all other benefits. Credit union membership is required to obtain a loan. The best way to be approved for a loan, whether at a bank or credit union, is to ensure you have maintained a history of responsibly paying off loans on-time and that you don't have too much debt compared to your ability to pay it off. There are other factors to consider as well, and they are detailed on our Financial Wellness Resource page.
A share certificate at a credit union works similar to a certificate of deposit, or CD, at a bank.

A membership share account is the basic savings account at a credit union that is the ownership stake for every member. This savings account, which must contain a minimum of $5, guarantees members the voting rights and other benefits of credit union membership.

We're glad you asked! While one of the great things about credit unions is access to exclusive, member-only benefits, we want the process of becoming a member to be intuitive and easy. To see if you qualify for membership and all the benefits that come with it, please click here. You can also simply start a membership application or loan application and we'll guide you along.
